name: Convection
text: A magical shot. If it destroys a living enemy, a warjack in the caster's CTRL gains a focus.
verify: Stand-in from Feora, Priestess of the Flame (app check pending).

name: Fire Step
text: Enemies within 2 inches of the caster take a fire damage roll, then she is placed within 2 inches. Once per activation.
verify: Duration TURN is a modelling trick so the engine runs the effect code (instant spells run none). Stand-in numbers.

name: Hex Hammer
text: An enemy that declares a spell in the caster's CTRL takes d3 damage first; if that destroys it, the spell fails. Lasts a round.
verify: Stand-in numbers. Needs a core call at spell declaration to bite.

name: Incite
text: Friendly Menoth models get +2 to attack and damage rolls against enemies within 10 inches of the caster. Lasts a turn.
